sections.Profile:
"Gin" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Chicago Coin Machine Manufacturing Company on November 15, 1974. The game features two flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, five drop targets, four rollover buttons, and two kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1974
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
